mechanism: p=2 with batch*m>=4 skips R11CrossRows and the DirectContinuous guard is widened to `(n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 8`, so both p=2 rows and 3<=p<=8 rows use the direct writer instead of DirectSmall or Packed10. No other runtime bytes change.
hypothesis: One direct row writer for all p<=8 avoids both the Cross packing and the DirectSmall per-output decode; tests whether DirectContinuous generalises better than DirectSmall.
proof: No new proof obligation: each edited `if` keeps both branches and their existing spec theorems; only the decidable predicate changes.

edits.old: if n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
edits.new: if (n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 8 then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
